degree_required.value: Doctor of Medicine or Doctor of Osteopathy or equivalent
degree_required.quote: The applicant shall possess the degree of doctor of medicine or doctor of osteopathy or its equivalent from a medical school which was approved by the board as of the time the degree was conferred.

accrediting_body.quote: from a medical school which was approved by the board as of the time the degree was conferred.

required.quote: The applicant shall have completed one (1) year of postgraduate training in a hospital or institution located in the United States, its possessions, or Canada that meets standards set by the board under IC 25-22.5-2-7.

kind.quote: postgraduate training in a hospital or institution located in the United States, its possessions, or Canada

exams.name: Examination for licensure
exams.quote: The applicant shall have successfully passed the examination for licensure or shall have satisfied the requirements for licensure by endorsement as prescribed by the board.

interval_years.quote: a license issued under this article expires biennially on the date established by the licensing agency

available.quote: The board in its discretion may register as a physician and may issue by endorsement an unlimited license to practice medicine or osteopathic medicine to any applicant who has: complied with the minimum requirements of IC 25-22.5-3; and passed an examination: for licensure in another state or territory of the United States, or Canada; or given by a recognized certifying agency approved by the board

requirements.value: Applicant must comply with minimum requirements and have passed examination in another state/territory or by recognized certifying agency approved by board; examination must be equivalent to Indiana's examination
requirements.quote: passed an examination: for licensure in another state or territory of the United States, or Canada; or given by a recognized certifying agency approved by the board; if that examination was, in the opinion of the board, equivalent in every respect to Indiana's examination at the time it was taken.

credential_type.quote: Any applicant who successfully passes the examination provided in chapter 4, and who meets all of the requirements of chapter 3, is entitled to be registered as a physician and to receive an unlimited license to practice medicine or osteopathic medicine.

is_mandatory.quote: It is unlawful for any person to practice medicine or osteopathic medicine in this state without holding a license or permit to do so, as provided in this article.

definition_quote.value: Practice of medicine or osteopathic medicine means any one or a combination of the following: Holding oneself out to the public as being engaged in: the diagnosis, treatment, correction, or prevention of any disease, ailment, defect, injury, infirmity, deformity, pain, or other condition of human beings; the suggestion, recommendation, or prescription or administration of any form of treatment, without limitation; the performing of any kind of surgical operation upon a human being; or the prevention of any physical, mental, or functional ailment or defect of any person. The maintenance of an office or a place of business for the reception, examination, or treatment of persons suffering from disease, ailment, defect, injury, infirmity, deformity, pain, or other conditions of body or mind.
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of medicine or osteopathic medicine" means any one (1) or a combination of the following: (1) Holding oneself out to the public as being engaged in: (A) the diagnosis, treatment, correction, or prevention of any disease, ailment, defect, injury, infirmity, deformity, pain, or other condition of human beings; (B) the suggestion, recommendation, or prescription or administration of any form of treatment, without limitation; (C) the performing of any kind of surgical operation upon a human being... or (D) the prevention of any physical, mental, or functional ailment or defect of any person. (2) The maintenance of an office or a place of business for the reception, examination, or treatment of persons suffering from disease, ailment, defect, injury, infirmity, deformity, pain, or other conditions of body or mind.

methods_authorized.quote: the diagnosis, treatment, correction, or prevention of any disease, ailment, defect, injury, infirmity, deformity, pain, or other condition of human beings; the suggestion, recommendation, or prescription or administration of any form of treatment, without limitation; the performing of any kind of surgical operation upon a human being

drug_authority.value: Physicians may prescribe drugs and medicines as defined in statute
drug_authority.quote: "Prescribe or prescription" means to direct, order, or designate the use of or manner of using a drug, medicine, or treatment, by spoken or written words or other means and in accordance with IC 25-1-9.3.

license_status_types.quote: Issue an unlimited license, a limited license, or a temporary medical permit, depending upon the qualifications of the applicant, to any applicant who successfully fulfills all of the requirements of this article.

foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.value: Foreign medical graduates must complete minimum of two (2) years of postgraduate training in a hospital or institution located in the United States or Canada which meets standards approved by nationally recognized medical or osteopathic accrediting bodies, or the board may waive the second year.
foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.quote: an applicant for licensure who: (1) has been graduated from a medical school outside the United States, its possessions, or Canada; and (2) submits evidence satisfactory to the board that prior to passing the examination the applicant has successfully completed a minimum of at least two (2) years of postgraduate training in a hospital or an institution located in the United States or Canada which meets the standards approved by the nationally recognized medical or osteopathic accrediting bodies in the United States, for the purpose of graduate training which is approved by the board; is entitled to receive an unlimited license to practice medicine or osteopathic medicine.

postgraduate_training_years_required.quote: The applicant shall have completed one (1) year of postgraduate training in a hospital or institution located in the United States, its possessions, or Canada that meets standards set by the board under IC 25-22.5-2-7.

telehealth_prescribing_rules.value: Providing diagnostic or treatment services to a person in Indiana when the diagnostic or treatment services are transmitted through electronic communications and are on a regular, routine, and nonepisodic basis or under an oral or written agreement to regularly provide medical services constitutes practice of medicine.
telehealth_prescribing_rules.quote: Providing diagnostic or treatment services to a person in Indiana when the diagnostic or treatment services: (A) are transmitted through electronic communications; and (B) are on a regular, routine, and nonepisodic basis or under an oral or written agreement to regularly provide medical services.

interstate_medical_licensure_compact_mem.quote: Administer the interstate medical licensure compact under IC 25-22.5-16, including appointing members to the interstate medical licensure compact commission and adopting any rules necessary to administer the compact.

physician_assistant_supervision_model.quote: has a collaborative agreement with a physician

compelled_mental_physical_exam_authority.quote: The applicant shall be physically and mentally capable of, and professionally competent to, safely engage in the practice of medicine or osteopathic medicine as determined by the board and shall submit: (1) to an examination; or (2) additional evidence to the board; if considered necessary by the board to determine such capability.

investigational_drug_protection.quote: An individual who consents under IC 34-18-12 may receive any experimental or nonconventional medical treatment if: (1) a licensed physician has personally examined the individual and agrees to treat the individual; (2) the treating physician determines: (A) there is no reasonable basis to conclude that the medical treatment, when administered as directed, poses an unreasonable and significant risk of danger to the individual receiving the medical treatment; or (B) the: (i) individual has been diagnosed with a terminal disease or condition and does not have comparable or satisfactory treatment options that are approved by the federal Food and Drug Administration
